title: The Fiction of the Human
designPurpose: A composed civic frame for the final fiction, balancing human systems, remembered names, and the shadow of the storyteller.

semanticPageTypes.cover: Official cover appears first, unnumbered, contained without cropping.
semanticPageTypes.titlePage: Source title-page paragraphs are centered as a cinematic frontispiece with the book title as the strongest first-page text.
semanticPageTypes.dedicationOrEpigraph: Dedicated and quoted matter receives quiet centered spacing and no decorative clutter.
semanticPageTypes.contents: TOC source lines preserve manuscript order while receiving narrative hierarchy.
semanticPageTypes.chapterOpening: Chapter openers use quiet vertical frame-lines like a city seen as memory and begin on fresh pages.
semanticPageTypes.normalContinuation: Warm paper, deep readable text, source anchors retained, and literary spacing preserved.
semanticPageTypes.sectionBreak: Small horizontal threshold mark using accent and warm counterpoint.
semanticPageTypes.pageNumbers: Small sans-serif numerals placed by the shared engine at the page foot.
semanticPageTypes.finalManuscriptPage: Ending, epilogue, and author pages carry a quieter lower-page atmospheric wash.
semanticPageTypes.feedbackSurface: One whole-book feedback surface after the manuscript, themed only by color and typography.

contentsStyle: Drawer uses scoped accent border, active row wash, and manuscript-derived jump labels.
feedbackStyle: Natural-height mobile expansion, no nested mobile scroll, full-width mobile fields, existing endpoint and payload.

responsiveAdaptations.mobile: Near full-width page, 17px body text, compact toolbar, simplified motifs, no horizontal overflow.
responsiveAdaptations.tablet: Centered page with balanced margins and clear chapter hierarchy.
responsiveAdaptations.desktop: Trade-book proportions with subtle edge and shadow.

futureWordMapping.margins: generous inner/outer margins matching reader proportions
futureWordMapping.sectionDividers: translate the threshold motif to hairline rules

futurePdfMapping.cover: Use higher-resolution artwork if available; current reader cover is a web/display source.
futurePdfMapping.runningElements: Small bottom page numbers; chapter openers begin on new pages.

printLimitations: Current official cover source is 1024x1536; useful as a reader and print-reference image but not guaranteed 300 DPI production cover art.
